name: helper-army-pace
description: The helper saves for its faction's main battle unit. A Foundry player with the helper on (army 24, scouting) against a very easy Foundry turtle on Desert Expanse, whose first attack comes at 12:00, so nothing interrupts the build-up. The helper must make tanks at a steady pace instead of the hover skimmers the bank covers first, and auto-expand must keep building. The power plant needs iron 20 with the keep and the tank 15; auto-expand builds its first plant when the grid runs short, in runs of seeds 3, 5 and 7 from 6:38 to 9:41 on main and from 4:06 to 8:31 with this change. A Foundry helper does not scout here: its scout is the drone, which needs an aircraft factory. The army checks at 8:00 and 10:00 subtract the city's militia (own:militia), which the harness's own:combat counts and the helper does not. The 4 s check reads the helper's own army line before the factory stands (7 to 11 s on these seeds): it must count no militia. The 10:00 check runs at the time limit, so it moves if minutes does. Run seeds 3, 5 and 7.
